preconditions.description: The graph has n vertices (4 ≤ n ≤ 5000) and m edges (n ≤ m ≤ 3n), where n and m are the first two integers read from stdin.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(v) <= n and 1 <= int(u) <= n and v != u for v, u in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge is represented by two integers v and u (1 ≤ v, u ≤ n), where edges is the list of all edges read from stdin.
The degree of any vertex in the graph is no more than 3, where degrees is the list of degrees for each vertex.

preconditions.expression: all(any(len(cycle) <= 5 and edge in cycle for cycle in find_cycles(edge) for edge in edges))
preconditions.description: For each edge, there exists at least one cycle of length no greater than 5 passing through that edge, where find_cycles(edge) returns all cycles containing the edge.
The graph is connected, where adjacency_list is the adjacency list representation of the graph.

postconditions.expression: any(bee_position == nastya_position for bee_position in current_bee_positions)
postconditions.description: The game ends when at least one of the bees and Nastya are in the same vertex at any time of the game, where current_bee_positions is the list of current positions of the three bees and nastya_position is Nastya's current position.
The game ends after at most n moves, where n is the number of vertices and moves is the list of moves made by the bees.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and 1 <= c <= n for a, b, c in move_sequence)
postconditions.description: Each move consists of three vertices a, b, c (1 ≤ a, b, c ≤ n), where move_sequence is the sequence of moves made by the bees.

postconditions.expression: all(adjacent(current_bee_positions[i], new_bee_positions[i]) or current_bee_positions[i] == new_bee_positions[i] for i in range(3))
postconditions.description: Each bee can either move along an edge from its current vertex or stay in place, where current_bee_positions and new_bee_positions are the positions before and after the move, respectively.
